第二天起来，王建新在空间里吃过早点，出了门。

他骑上青马，大毛它们五个跟在后面，怀里还揣着小狐狸，开始了巡边工作。雪还没化，草原上白茫茫一片，但比一个月前薄了不少，有些地方已经露出了枯黄的草尖。

沿着铁丝网走了一圈，没发现什么异常。但蒙古国那边，雪地上多了好多脚印，一串一串的，沿着他们的铁丝网延伸。看样子他们也在巡边，而且不止一个人，脚印很杂。

“应该是他们也有人在巡边。”王建新看了看那些脚印，没太在意。上次搞了那么大动静，对面加强巡逻也是正常的。

上午慢悠悠地巡逻完。有些地方的铁丝网被雪压歪了，木桩子斜了，铁丝松了。他下了马，把木桩扶正，用脚踩实了周围的土，把铁丝重新绷紧，绑在木桩上。忙活了一阵，弄好了几处，便没啥事了。

骑着马往回走的时候，王建新心里盘算着。马上进入三月份了，天就暖和了。雪一化，路一通，送物资的人肯定要来。说不定还要检查检查他这几个月干得怎么样，看看他是不是还活着。

“看来得需要做做样子了。”

接下来的日子，王建新隔几天巡一次边防。其他时间，他都在做表面功夫。

土坯房周围全是雪，得铲掉。他找出一把铁锹，把房子四周的雪铲得干干净净，堆到远处去。门口的雪也铲了，铲出一条路来，一直通到羊圈和菜地。干了两天，全部搞定。

地还冻得硬邦邦的，铁锹都铲不动。但他还是开始翻地，硬翻。一锹下去，咔的一声，只铲起一小块土疙瘩。他不着急，一天翻一点，慢慢地翻。翻出来的土块用铁锹拍碎，把地整平。

他把原来那一亩多地硬生生地扩到了三亩多。原来只有一小块菜地，现在扩大了好几倍。虽然现在啥也没种，但地翻好了，等着开春就能种。

“关键是，没有柴火。”

王建新想了想，这一冬天他是怎么熬过来的？在空间里住着，根本不用烧柴。但外人不知道。送物资的人来了，一看他门口连个柴火垛都没有，怎么解释？难道说我在屋里冻了一冬天没死？

“这边也捡不上牛粪。”他看了看四周，草原上雪盖着，啥也没有。不知道他们平时是咋回事，是不是冬天会给送牛粪也不知道。但就算送，他也没收到——大雪封路，物资送不来，牛粪自然也来不了。

“看来得转悠着砍棵树回来。”

王建新骑着马，在附近转悠着找树。草原上的树可是很难找，除了河边偶尔有几棵，其他地方光秃秃的。他跑了十几里地，才在一条干河沟边上发现一棵枯树。树不大，碗口粗，死了不知道多久，树干干裂了，但没有倒。

他取出工具——一把锯子，一把斧头。先把树枝砍掉，再把树干锯成几段，收入空间。收拾利索了，骑上马，慢慢地回到土坯房。

到了门口，他把木材从空间里取出来，堆在房子旁边。然后用斧头把那些木材劈成柴火，长短粗细差不多，码得整整齐齐。码了一小垛，不多，但看着像那么回事了。

“到最后来检查时就说，搞了一棵大枯树，节省着烧着，这是剩下的一点。你们再不来，真就快冻死了。”王建新拍了拍手上的木屑，满意地点了点头。

When he got up the next day, Wang Jianxin had breakfast in the space and went out.

He mounted the green horse, followed by Da Mao and the other five, carrying the little fox in his arms, and began patrolling the border.The snow has not yet melted, and the grassland is completely white, but it is much thinner than a month ago, and the tips of the yellow grass are already exposed in some places.

I walked around the barbed wire fence and found nothing unusual.But over in Mongolia, there were many footprints on the snow, one after another, extending along their barbed wire fence.It seemed that they were also patrolling the border, and there was more than one of them, and their footprints were very mixed.

"It should be that they also have people patrolling the border." Wang Jianxin looked at the footprints and didn't pay much attention.There was such a big commotion last time, so it's normal for the patrols on the other side to be stepped up.

The morning patrol was completed slowly.In some places, the barbed wire fence was crooked by the weight of snow, the wooden posts were tilted, and the wires were loose.He dismounted, straightened the wooden stake, stepped on the surrounding soil with his feet, tightened the wire again, and tied it to the wooden stake.After working hard for a while, I finished a few things and then everything was fine.

While riding back, Wang Jianxin was thinking about it.It's almost March and the weather is getting warmer.Once the snow melts and the road becomes clear, people delivering supplies will definitely come.Maybe check to see how he's been doing these past few months to see if he's still alive.

"It seems that we need to show off."

In the days that followed, Wang Jianxin patrolled the border every few days.The rest of the time, he was doing superficial things.

There was snow all around the adobe house and it had to be shoveled away.He found a shovel, shoveled the snow around the house cleanly, and piled it away.The snow at the door was also shoveled, and a path was shoveled that led to the sheep pen and vegetable field.After two days of work, it was all done.

The ground was still so frozen that I couldn't move it with a shovel.But he still started to turn over the ground, hard.The shovel went down, and with a click, only a small lump of soil was shoveled up.He was not in a hurry, turning over a little bit every day, slowly.Crush the excavated soil with a shovel and level the ground.

He expanded the land from one acre to more than three acres.There used to be only a small vegetable plot, but now it has expanded several times.Although nothing has been planted now, the ground has been plowed and can be planted in spring.

"The thing is, there's no firewood."

Wang Jianxin thought for a while, how did he survive this winter?Living in space, there is no need to burn firewood at all.But outsiders don't know.When the person delivering supplies arrived, he saw that there wasn’t even a pile of firewood at his door. How to explain it?Could it be that I didn’t die after being frozen in the house all winter?

"You can't pick up cow dung here either." He looked around. There was nothing on the grassland covered with snow.I don’t know what they usually do, and I don’t know if they give cow dung in winter.But even if he sent it, he didn't receive it - the road was blocked due to heavy snow, so the supplies couldn't be delivered, and naturally the cow dung couldn't come.

"Looks like I have to wander back and chop down a tree."

Wang Jianxin rode his horse and wandered around looking for trees.It's hard to find trees on the grassland. Except for a few trees by the river, the rest of the place is bare.He ran for more than ten miles before he found a dead tree beside a dry ditch.The tree was not big, with a thick mouth. It had been dead for who knows how long. The trunk was cracked, but it did not fall.

He took out his tools - a saw, an axe.First cut off the branches, then saw the trunk into several sections to fit into the space.After tidying up, I got on my horse and slowly returned to the adobe house.

At the door, he took the wood out of the space and piled it next to the house.Then use an ax to split the wood into firewood, which is about the same length and thickness, and is neatly stacked.There was a small stack, not much, but it looked like that.

"When I finally came to inspect, I said that I built a big dead tree and saved it for burning. This is what's left. If you don't come, you will freeze to death." Wang Jianxin patted the sawdust on his hands and nodded with satisfaction.
